summary: Drop appended Taylor commentary chunks in orphic-hymns (17 sub-split editorial chunks, 80 accepted tags + 399 edges)
description:
Chunking gap found in PR #83 re-review (finding #1, raised by ivy + corpus-quality).

The front-matter drop removed the 34 leading editorial chunks, but the same class of Taylor commentary survives as sub-split (part N) chunks on note-heavy hymn pages: when a page exceeds max_tokens=800 it splits into a hymn part and a commentary/footnote tail that inherits the hymn's label.

VERIFIED against corpus + DB on branch corpus-quality/orphic-hymns-front-matter-drop: 17 chunks (of 103) whose body does NOT open with a hymn number — pure Taylor essay/footnote prose labelled as hymn parts:
- 087-090 'Hymn LXXV. THE MUSES (part 2-5)': essay on the Muses (Plato's Phædrus, poetic fury, Thamyris) — 25 accepted tags, 81 edges
- 103 'Hymn LXXXVI. DEATH (part 2)': commerce/philosophy essay — 15 tags, 32 edges
- plus 006/010/012/014/016/019/035/039/042/043/052/099 (footnote tails of Protogonus, Moon, Nature, Hercules, Rhea, Proserpine, Pallas, Apollo, Mises, Vesta pages)
TOTAL: 80 accepted tags + 399 live edges on editorial prose labelled as hymns. A query for 'the Muses'/'Orphic theology' still returns ~3000 tokens of Taylor's essay labeled 'Hymn LXXV. THE MUSES' — the exact defect PR #83 claims to fix, just relabeled.

NOT fixable by config: drop_before_marker only strips the leading block; drop_chunk_patterns is a whole-chunk per-body regex and the commentary shares pages with the hymns. Needs a chunk.py mechanism change: flag/drop the split-off editorial tail (e.g. sub-split parts that do not open with the section's own number+invocation are commentary, not primary text).

Suggested approach: in page_chunker sub-split, drop trailing sub-chunks that do not begin with a hymn number pattern (the (part N) tail is editorial); or post-hoc: drop the 17 chunks + remap tags (apparatus_remap.py) + re-embed.

DB backup required before any remap. Separate ticket from df44bdeb (front-matter drop) — do not block PR #83 on it.
